mapper.select: SELECT id, category, sub_category, indicator_code, title, value_type, description, unit, is_active FROM esg_indicators ORDER BY category, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO esg_indicators (category, sub_category, indicator_code, title, value_type, description, unit, is_active) VALUES (#{category}::esg_category_enum, #{subCategory}, #{indicatorCode}, #{title}, #{valueType}::indicator_value_type_enum, #{description}, #{unit}, true)
mapper.update: UPDATE esg_indicators SET category = #{category}::esg_category_enum, sub_category = #{subCategory}, indicator_code = #{indicatorCode}, title = #{title}, value_type = #{valueType}::indicator_value_type_enum, description = #{description}, unit = #{unit}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
